mentions.name: ShelfSwap
mentions.description: A web platform for swapping physical books and connecting with other readers. It was built as an end-to-end Go backend project covering API design, data modeling, and deployment, with AI-assisted development.
mentions.problem: Books are getting expensive, and many readers already have shelves of good books they are done with.
mentions.audience: Readers who want to swap books they are done with
mentions.source_excerpt: Built ShelfSwap (https://shelfswap.io). I enjoy reading, but books are getting expensive, and many of us already have shelves of good books we’re done with. This is a simple platform to swap physical books and connect with other readers.
